# Frontier source-model controls

`positive-controls.json` covers 151 float32-rounded synthetic AP1 inputs, 193 neutral inputs and 144 ordinary chart/inset inputs. Independent NumPy calculations apply the standard-primary/Bradford basis, analytic radial compression, shared characteristic, diagonal neutral slopes and native trilinear interpolation. The recorded chart drives distinguish active compression from identity; neutral codes protect the calibrated trajectory. Inputs include black, signed/HDR light, moderate colours and near-black rays. No photographs or original vendor files are included.

`negative-controls.json` covers 49 synthetic inputs across all 16 stocks. Dye coefficients, base-relative scanner OD and exact-scene-grey OD come from the executed pinned Spektrafilm source; [formation tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/negative/tests.rs) check them independently of code mapping. NumPy mean-preserving balance, diagonal bank slopes and native trilinear interpolation derive code/AP1 expectations. Input locations and physical formation facts are separate from the rendering calibration.

[Source tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/tests.rs) compare the model with these independent controls and exercise native addressing, shared LUT vertices, cancellation and finite-input admission. [Positive tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/positive/tests.rs) independently derive the fixed standard basis and check the compression shoulder. [Stock tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/negative/tests.rs) check native grey anchors, diagonal/affine mapping, OD-strength preservation and base-flux normalization.

Creative65 identities identify independently verified accepted numeric artifacts, not physical accuracy. Positive baked-black controls use analytic interpolation between two diagonal nodes of those artifacts; source black and off-grid creative-cube black need not coincide. The opt-in accepted-appearance diagnostic compares supplied accepted bakes and native/control carriers without requiring private photographs in ordinary tests.

`legacy-none-{a,b}.json` retain 27 samples of captured pedestal-based None LUTs; `legacy-portra-{a,b}.json` retain the corresponding affine-stock LUT samples. These compact 3³ assets protect [saved-project authority](../../look_project.rs): catalogue labels reopen the captured numbers rather than regenerate the current model.

[Composed GPU tests](../../../src/photographic/graph/output_tests.rs) compare creative-LUT execution plus both output targets with scalar interpolation and OCIO. Analytic LUT fixtures separately exercise interpolation, including unregistered providers. [EXR tests](../../../src/gpu_export/job/tests/starting_exposure.rs) cover scene bypass; [storage tests](../../../src/looks/storage.rs) cover exact sample serialization. These checks distinguish execution fidelity from creative-cube approximation and photographic judgement.
